title: Open Science Desktop: Run AI Research Agents Locally on Your PC
description:
Open Science Desktop is a free, open-source desktop app that runs AI research agents on your own machine. It handles the full research loop — exploring literature, running experiments, analyzing data, and writing papers — while keeping everything local and auditable. Download for Mac, Windows, or Linux.
